spans.s:
स्कद (इ, ङ) स्कन्दते 1.
d. To leap,
jump, raise; to spill, inundate;
to be dry.

स्कन्द स्कन्दति 1.
a. To go; to be dry;
to emit; with अव, to assail; with
आ, to enter.

स्कन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. Skanda or
Kārti-
keya, the Hindu Mars; a king;
the body; bank of a river;
learned man; name of a
Purāna.

स्कन्दित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Gone; effused.

स्कन्ध-चाप (पः) 1.
m. Sort of yoke
for carrying burdens.

स्कन्ध-ज (जः) 1.
m. A tree which
grows from a principal stem.

स्कन्ध-तरु (रुः) 2.
m. The cocoa-nut
tree.

स्कन्ध-देश (शः) 1.
m. The withers
of an elephant, where the rider
sits; the shoulder.

स्कन्ध-फल (लः) 1.
m. The cocoa-nut
tree; the
Bel tree; the glomer-
ous fig.

स्कन्ध-बन्धना (ना) 1.
f. A sort of fennel.

स्कन्ध-मल्लक (कः) 1.
m. A heron.

स्कन्ध-रुह (हः) 1.
m. The Indian fig
tree.

स्कन्ध-वाह (हः) 1.
m. An ox of burthen.

स्कन्ध-वाहक (कः) 1.
m. Idem.

स्कन्ध-शाखा (खा) 1.
f. The principal
branch of a tree.

स्कन्ध-शृङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. A buffalo.

स्कन्धा_ग्नि (ग्निः) 2.
m. Stem of a tree
on fire.

स्कन्धा_नल (लः) 1.
m. Idem.

स्कन्धा_वार (रः) 1.
m. An army, or
division of it attached to the
king; royal capital; camp.

स्कन्धिक (कः) 1.
m. An ox of bur-
then.

स्कन्धिन् (न्धी) 5.
m. A tree.

स्कन्धो_पनेय (यः-या-यं)
a. To be car-
ried on the shoulders.
m. A con-
ciliatory offering.

स्कन्न (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Fallen down, oozed.

स्कभ् (ङ, न, ग) स्कम्भते 1.
d. To stop or
hinder; to be dull. Also स्कभ्नोति
5.
a. and स्कभ्नाति 9.
a.
